PROJECT_NAME.description: OpenStack service/project name used for paths and user/group names.

SYSTEM_USER.description: System user account under which the worker runs.

SYSTEM_GROUP.description: System group for the worker process.

CONFIG_FILE.description: Path to the main Barbican configuration file.

PIDFILE.description: Path to the PID file for the barbican-worker process.

LOGFILE.description: Path to the log file for the worker process.

UWSGI_INI_PATH.description: Path to the uWSGI configuration file (used when deploying via uWSGI).

UWSGI_PORT.description: Port for uWSGI to bind to.

UWSGI_BIND_IP.description: IP address for uWSGI to bind to.

UWSGI_PROCESSES.description: Number of worker processes for uWSGI (including leading space for CLI args).
